personality.description: This person tends to keep detailed plans, track small errors carefully, and prepare well in advance, while also looking for creative or unconventional ways to improve what is already there. In daily life, they are warm and cooperative, often checking how others feel and adjusting their behavior to preserve harmony, though they may privately worry a great deal and revisit decisions repeatedly. When facing moral dilemmas, they try to understand all sides, feel strongly affected by harm or unfairness, and usually seek a compassionate compromise that avoids unnecessary conflict. In group discussions, they speak thoughtfully and precisely, contributing ideas without dominating, and they often soften disagreements with careful, considerate language.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
